_doc: Each mutant re-introduces a real v0.3.x regression (the reverse of its fix commit). test/release/checks.py mutants applies each one to a copy of topaz/, runs the non-slow suite against it, and requires every catcher to fail with an assertion failure. A catcher is a substring matched against '<junit classname>::<test name>'.

mutants.bug: pixels_given_radius always builds a 3D grid, inflating the 2D particle pixel count by 2r+1 (pi 7x too high at r=3)
KDTree.query result unpacked as (idx, dist), so negative crops are sampled on particles
worker_init_fn not passed to the training DataLoader, so all workers emit identical batches
